newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Man sets himself ablaze outside Kremlin - Tass.
newsitem.headline: Man sets himself ablaze outside Kremlin - Tass.

text.p: A man set himself ablaze on Thursday in a suicide bid on Red Square shortly after President Boris Yeltsin gave a keynote policy speech in the Kremlin to Russian parliamentarians, Itar-Tass news agency said.
The unidentified man, said to be about 40, received serious burns and was taken away in a state of shock, Tass said.
Police said they had no information on the incident.

Earlier on Thursday Yeltsin told deputies in his annual state-of-the-nation address that urgent measures were needed to resolve Russia's many economic and social problems and combat crime and corruption.
